description: What the account has left. On a plan with a rate limit this is the smaller of what the account holds and what is left in the current 7-day period (period_* describe that week, and period_resets_at is when the week resets); on a metered plan it is the account's lead balance. On a rate-limited plan with a monthly allowance, the note names the allowance when it can be read.
name: get_balance
title: Get lead balance
